caption:
💜 Fiorentina won 4–2 at Sassuolo on Monday night.

label: LALIGA · MON NOV 2
headline: Depor come from behind
sub: Budimir put Osasuna ahead (32'). Mario Soriano's free kick (64') and Bil Nsongo (87') won it.
caption:

Ante Budimir scored first, then Mario Soriano curled in a free kick and Bil Nsongo won it with three minutes left.

How far can Depor go this season? 👇

label: MONDAY NIGHT FOOTBALL · WEEK 8
headline: Bears roll in Seattle
sub: Caleb Williams: 247 yards, 1 TD, no turnovers. D'Andre Swift ran in 3 touchdowns.
caption:
🐻 The Bears beat the Seahawks 34–17 on Monday Night Football and move to 6–2.

Caleb Williams threw for 247 yards with no turnovers, and D'Andre Swift scored three rushing touchdowns. Seattle fall to 4–4.

Are the Bears for real? 👇

#DaBears #MNF #Seahawks

label: NFL · BEARS 34, SEAHAWKS 17
headline: Jeffery Simmons' Bears debut: instant impact
sub: Sack on the opening drive, 6 tackles, a tackle for loss and a pass defended. Seattle went 1 for 11 on third down.
caption:
💥 The Bears sent Tennessee a package including two first-round picks for Jeffery Simmons last week. Monday night showed why.

He sacked Sam Darnold on the opening drive, and Chicago held Seattle to 252 yards and one third-down conversion.

Trade of the year? 👇

#DaBears #NFL #MNF

caption:

label: NBA · MON NOV 2 · OVERTIME
headline: No more unbeaten teams
sub: Memphis were 6–0. Ty Jerome scored 40 but his last-second shot missed. Zion had 9 of his 25 in OT.
caption:

Jeremiah Fears hit two free throws with 7.3 seconds left, Zion Williamson scored 9 of his 25 in OT, and Ty Jerome's 40 wasn't enough.

#Pelicans #GrizzNation #NBA

caption:
